legend.territory: Claimable water territory (green on the profile map)
legend.neutral: Neutral / courtship ground (yellow on the profile map)

notes: Spinosaurus claim medium water sources inside specific territory areas and may only hunt other players from within them. Territoriality is suppressed at neutral grounds.

pois.note: Prime claimable freshwater basin (Greater & Lesser Stillwater Territory). Hunts of other players may only start here.
Brackish mudflat claim (Greater & Lesser Mudflats Territory).
Wet forest water claim (Greater & Lesser Twisted Territory).
Segmented claimable water among the volcanic islands.
South-western water claim (Greater & Lesser Redwoods Territory).
Ancestral neutral ground. Sub-adults migrate here to mature and secure a first pairbond; territoriality is suppressed and the water is not claimable.
Alternate partner-seeking ground alongside Triad Falls.
New-pair courtship ground & neutral area (yellow on the profile map).

anyPoiHunting.note: Fish, Leedsichthys and Tylosaurus may be hunted in any POI; other player hunts are restricted to claimed territory.
